name: MonarchTagInput
title: TagInput
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.FlowRow of MonarchTag (androidx.compose.material3.AssistChip) and androidx.compose.foundation.text.BasicTextField with ImeAction.Done, MonarchButton suggestions, and a polite liveRegion
summary: A field that edits a list of short values as removable tags, with validation, paste splitting and optional suggestions.
whenToUse: For a short list of free values: skills, labels, keywords, email recipients.
whenNotToUse: For a choice among known options use filter chips (MonarchTag with selected) or a multi-select. For one value use MonarchTextField.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchTagInput(tags: List<String>, onTagsChange: (List<String>) -> Unit, label: String, removeIcon: @Composable () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, readOnly: Boolean = false, placeholder: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, suggestions: List<String> = emptyList(), separators: Set<Char> = setOf(','), maxCount: Int? = null, allowDuplicates: Boolean = false, normalize: ((String) -> String)? = null, validate: ((String, List<String>) -> String?)? = null, suggestionIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, errorIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchTagInputLabels = MonarchTagInputLabels(), interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

public class MonarchTagInputLabels(duplicate: ((String) -> String)? = null, maximum: ((Int) -> String)? = null, added: ((String) -> String)? = null, removed: ((String) -> String)? = null, remove: ((String) -> String)? = null, addSuggestion: ((String) -> String)? = null)

options.name: tags
options.description: The tags, in order.

options.name: onTagsChange
options.description: Called with the new list when a tag is added or removed.

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label; also the TalkBack name of the text field.

options.name: removeIcon
options.description: The close mark of each tag. Monarch bundles no icons, so the app passes one; it is decorative.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the field.

options.name: enabled
options.description: false shows the tags without remove and disables the text field.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Shows the tags without remove and without the text field.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Text in the empty text field.

options.name: helperText
options.description: Help under the box, such as how values are separated.

options.name: errorText
options.description: An error from the app. A refused tag's message replaces it while shown. A blank string is no error.

options.name: suggestions
options.description: Values offered as buttons under the box while the typed text matches them (without case). Added values are left out; at most 8 show.

options.name: separators
options.description: Characters that add the typed text, besides Done. New lines and tabs also split a paste.

options.name: maxCount
options.description: The most tags. Further additions are refused with "You can add up to N."

options.name: allowDuplicates
options.description: Whether the same tag may appear twice. Duplicates are compared without case.

options.name: normalize
options.description: Cleans typed text before it is checked and added. Trims white space by default.

options.name: validate
options.description: Returns a message to refuse a tag, or null to accept it. Runs after the duplicate and maximum checks.

options.name: suggestionIcon
options.description: An icon before each suggestion, such as a plus.

options.name: errorIcon
options.description: An icon before the error message.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the duplicate and maximum messages, the announcements and the TalkBack names of the remove and suggestion buttons.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The source of the focus interactions of the text field.

states.name: empty
states.description: Only the text field, with its placeholder.

states.name: with tags
states.description: Small neutral tags wrap before the text field and the box grows; each tag removes itself when activated.

states.name: focused
states.description: The border takes the focus ring color.

states.name: refused entry
states.description: The refused text stays in the field; the border and the message under the box take the strong danger color; the message is announced and clears when the user types.

states.name: error
states.description: The app's error, shown like a refusal while no tag is refused.

states.name: suggestions
states.description: Matching suggestions appear as ghost buttons under the box while text is typed.

states.name: read only
states.description: Tags without remove; no text field; a subtle fill.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Tags without remove, the text field disabled, the subtle fill and the disabled text color.

appearance: The box has the surface fill with the input border, the focus ring color while focused and the strong danger color with an error; disabled and read-only boxes use the subtle fill and the default border. Tags are MonarchTag in the neutral tone at the small size. The same roles apply in every theme.
platformNotes: The parity map names InputChip; the tags are MonarchTag, which is built on AssistChip because a selectable InputChip is read by TalkBack as an unchecked checkbox. The web's keyboard shortcuts (Backspace in the empty field to reach the last tag, arrow keys between tags) are not offered: every tag is a real button TalkBack reaches. Suggestions are buttons under the box instead of a combobox listbox. The web's sizes, addOnBlur and name for hidden form inputs are not offered. A paste is told apart from typing by the number of characters inserted at once, as on iOS. Monarch bundles no icons, so the close mark of the tags is a required slot. The typed text is kept by the field (rememberSaveable); the tags are hoisted.
accessibility: The text field is named by the label, and carries the refusal or the app's error as its error; the visible label and message are hidden from TalkBack so they are not read twice.
Each removable tag is one button named "Remove" and the tag, with a 48dp touch target, and can be renamed with labels.remove.
Additions ("Added Research."), removals ("Removed Research.") and refusals are announced through an always-present polite live region.
After a tag is removed or a suggestion added, focus returns to the text field.
Suggestion buttons are named "Add" and the suggestion and have 48dp touch targets; the text field is at least 48dp high.
Messages are text (with an optional icon), not color alone.
edgeCases: Pasting "a, b, c" adds three tags; parts that are refused stay in the field joined by commas.
Tags are compared without case for duplicates, so "research" is refused when "Research" is there.
A long tag takes a row of its own in the flow layout.
Tags are identified by position, so duplicate tags (with allowDuplicates) can each be removed.
Typing a separator in the middle of the text adds the part before it and keeps the part after it.

examples.title: Skills with suggestions
examples.template:
MonarchTagInput(
    tags = skills,
    onTagsChange = { skills = it },
    label = {{label}},
    removeIcon = { MonarchIcon(imageVector = SampleIcons.Close, contentDescription = null) },
    placeholder = {{placeholder}},
    suggestions = listOf({{suggestions.0}}, {{suggestions.1}}, {{suggestions.2}}, {{suggestions.3}}, {{suggestions.4}}, {{suggestions.5}}),
    maxCount = {{max}},
)
examples.code:
MonarchTagInput(
    tags = skills,
    onTagsChange = { skills = it },
    label = "Skills",
    removeIcon = { MonarchIcon(imageVector = SampleIcons.Close, contentDescription = null) },
    placeholder = "Add a skill",
    suggestions = listOf("Accessibility", "Copywriting", "Data analysis", "Illustration", "Research", "TypeScript"),
    maxCount = 8,
)

examples.title: Email recipients with validation
examples.code:
MonarchTagInput(
    tags = recipients,
    onTagsChange = { recipients = it },
    label = "Recipients",
    removeIcon = { MonarchIcon(imageVector = SampleIcons.Close, contentDescription = null) },
    placeholder = "name@example.com",
    separators = setOf(',', ' ', ';'),
    normalize = { it.trim().lowercase() },
    validate = { tag, _ -> if ('@' in tag) null else "Enter an email address like name@example.com." },
)

examples.title: Read only
examples.code:
MonarchTagInput(
    tags = listOf("Billing", "Priority"),
    onTagsChange = {},
    label = "Labels",
    removeIcon = {},
    readOnly = true,
)
